turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi Elena, Sarah here. Let us talk about your property enquiry.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I need a flexible sale date, but I am not accepting an offer blindly.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That makes sense. A review should consider the property condition, comparable sales, and your preferred timeline, with a written explanation of the proposed terms.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Will I have to decide during the appointment?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: No. The appointment is to gather information and explain the process. You should have time to review the offer and seek advice before making a commitment.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That is helpful. Could we review the details tomorrow afternoon?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Certainly, Elena. In this demo, we would capture those notes and request a suitable appointment.
